extensionAttribute.description: Counts non-XML files in /Library/Application Support/JAMF/Waiting Room/. These are packages cached by Jamf for later install.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Number of Cached Packages Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon
room="/Library/Application Support/JAMF/Waiting Room"
if [[ ! -d "$room" ]]; then echo "<result>0</result>" exit 0 fi
count=$(/bin/ls -1 "$room" 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -cv 'xml$')
echo "<result>${count:-0}</result>"
